entries: For the offshore Merryweather approach, Trevor steals a Cargobob helicopter from Fort Zancudo.
Trevor leads Michael and Franklin in stealing a high-value Merryweather device, but Lester forces them to return it because it is too dangerous.
Lester sends Franklin to kill Bilkinton CEO Brett Lowrey. It is the only assassination required for story progression and introduces stock-market manipulation.
The protagonists acquire matching work suits as preparation for Blitz Play.
The protagonists buy masks for the Blitz Play armored-car ambush.
Trevor steals a garbage truck required for Blitz Play.
Franklin steals a tow truck required for Blitz Play.
Michael, Franklin, and Trevor ambush an armored security vehicle for the FIB using a staged roadblock and heavy gunfight.
I Fought the Law... gta v
Franklin, Michael, and Trevor steal a Cheetah and Entity XF for Devin Weston after a high-speed freeway setup.
Eye in the Sky gta v
Trevor uses a police helicopter camera to help Franklin locate and steal a Z-Type for Devin Weston.
Michael helps producer Solomon Richards deal with actor and director problems at Richards Majestic.
Michael shoots down a private jet for Martin Madrazo while Trevor tracks the crash and retrieves a package.
Franklin infiltrates a film set and steals a JB 700 for Devin Weston.
Trevor flies a crop duster into the path of a Merryweather cargo plane and attempts to steal the aircraft.
Michael, Trevor, and Lester scout the Paleto Bay bank and plan the Paleto Score.
Franklin, Michael, Trevor, and Chop hunt surviving O'Neil brothers in the forest after their vehicle crashes.
The crew steals military equipment needed for the Paleto Score.
Michael, Trevor, Franklin, and a gunman rob the Paleto Bay bank and fight through a massive police response using heavy armor and weapons.
Trevor and Michael rob a train and recover valuable cargo in the Alamo Sea area.
The trio conduct an FIB operation at Humane Labs involving infiltration, a chemical agent, and underwater extraction.
Trevor's stay at Floyd's apartment ends violently, after which Trevor takes control of the Vanilla Unicorn.
Michael, Trevor, Franklin, and Lester survey the Union Depository and plan possible ways to rob it.
Michael and Trevor travel to North Yankton, where Trevor discovers the truth about Brad and Michael's old deal.
Franklin, Lamar, and Trevor transport Devin Weston's stolen cars toward a delivery point and deal with police pursuit.
Franklin tracks Michael's phone and rescues him from the Triads at a meat-processing facility.
The Ballad of Rocco gta v
Michael helps Solomon Richards after Rocco Pelosi attacks the producer and threatens the film project.
Cleaning out the Bureau gta v
Michael and Lester identify a way into FIB headquarters and prepare for the Bureau Raid.
Franklin steals the FIB building plans from an architect, enabling Lester to plan the Bureau Raid approach.
For the covert Bureau Raid approach, Franklin steals a fire truck for the crew's disguise and escape.
Michael and Franklin infiltrate FIB headquarters to steal and destroy incriminating data. The mission can use a fire-crew or roof-entry approach.
Michael meets Dave Norton at the Kortz Center, where FIB, IAA, and Merryweather forces converge in a large firefight.
Michael works toward repairing his relationship with Amanda, Jimmy, and Tracey.
Michael pursues Molly Schultz to recover Solomon Richards' film after Devin Weston threatens the studio.
Franklin, Michael, and Trevor rescue Lamar from a Ballas trap arranged through Stretch.
Michael attends the premiere of Solomon's film Meltdown and then races home to protect his family from Merryweather.
Planning The Big Score gta v
The protagonists and Lester choose the subtle or obvious approach for robbing the Union Depository.
For the subtle Big Score approach, the crew steals police spike strips.
For the subtle Big Score approach, Franklin locates and modifies three Bravado Gauntlets as getaway cars.
For the obvious Big Score approach, the crew steals a large drilling machine.
For the obvious Big Score approach, the crew steals a freight locomotive and rail car.
Michael, Franklin, Trevor, Lester, and hired crew rob the Union Depository. The subtle and obvious approaches use different methods, setups, and crew roles.
Ending A. Franklin follows Steve Haines' demand to kill Trevor. Trevor is permanently lost from that save afterward.
Ending B. Franklin follows Devin Weston's demand to kill Michael. Michael is permanently lost from that save afterward.
Ending C, also called Deathwish. Franklin refuses to kill Michael or Trevor; the trio unite against the FIB, Merryweather, and their remaining enemies, allowing all three protagonists to survive.
